peopleAlsoAsk.question: Is 1 carat diamond 1 gram?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: Carat is the unit of measurement for the physical weight of diamonds. One carat equals 0.200 grams or 1/5 gram and is subdivided into 100 points. For comparison, in units more familiar in the United States, one carat equals 0.007 ounce avoirdupois.
